title: The ranked order flags two of the four weak candidates and ranks the other two in the top four without a flag
The tinychannels row says diff -rq prints only wiki/ lines, and it prints 34 lines of which 13 are wiki/

detail: R7-P2-001 is annotation-inconsistency: two of four weak candidates carry a Weak flag in the ranked order and two do not, so the order reads as claiming those two are confirmed. R7-P2-002 is false-evidence: the parenthetical offered as proof of the tinychannels conclusion is false about the command it names, while the conclusion itself survives. Neither is a P1 because the correct information is present in the table one screen up and no recommendation changes.
